resolvedQuestions.text: Where is mk_code_index / system-code-graph registered across MCP configs, plugins, and runtime manifests (after symlink dedupe)?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Four physical MCP configs (opencode.json, .claude/mcp.json, .codex/config.toml, .pi/mcp.json) plus launchers/plugins; CLAUDE/.mcp.json/.cursor/mcp.json are symlink aliases.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which skills, agents, commands, hooks, and doctrine files grant or require code-graph tools?
resolvedQuestions.answer: ≥30 agents across 4 runtimes; Claude/Codex/Devin/Cursor/Pi/git freshness hooks; AGENTS/README/gate-tool-routing doctrine; doctor code-graph route; create-* templates; install guides; advisor edges.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which imports, shell-outs, scripts, CI jobs, and doctor routes invoke the code-graph stack?
resolvedQuestions.answer: code-graph-boundary + enrichment/session callers; isolation-check.yml; session-cleanup/orphan-sweeper/worktree/launcher-bridge/spec-memory-launcher; deploy-mcp; doctor-update order.

resolvedQuestions.text: What ordering constraints and rollback risks govern safe decommission vs keep-behind-fallback?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Disable hooks → stub boundary → unregister MCP → retire bins → doctor/advisor/agents → delete skill → retarget CI. Highest risk: skill-before-stub and hooks-after-unregister.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which hits are archival/generated/symlink-duplicates and must not drive live mutations?
resolvedQuestions.answer: .opencode/specs/** (4364), skill changelogs, benchmark reports, worktrees/logs noise; symlink aliases; coverage-graph false positive; .env.local untracked.
